app_tagline: Visualize restaurant inventory and prevent waste
about_description: Upload an inventory CSV to get consumption trend graphs and low-stock alerts. Powered by DuckDB. Includes menu cost calculation and per-item reorder alerts.
pain_point_description: Restaurant inventory management is chaotic. No easy way to know what's running low.
upload_help: Upload a CSV with item name, quantity, unit, unit price, and date columns
no_file: Please upload an inventory CSV file.
desktop_recommended: This app is optimized for desktop use
reorder_point_help: Set a reorder threshold per item. Items set to 0 will use the global threshold.
reorder_recommend_msg: {count} item(s) are at or below their reorder point. Consider placing an order.
menu_register_help: Register menu items with selling price and ingredients to track food costs
menu_ingredients_help: Match ingredient names to stock item names for automatic unit price lookup
menu_empty: No menus registered yet. Go to the "Menu Registration" tab to add one.
cost_ratio_high: Food cost ratio exceeds 35%. Consider reviewing this menu.
cost_ratio_ok: Food cost ratio is within a healthy range.
cost_ratio_no_price: Cannot calculate cost — no unit price data in inventory CSV. Include a unit_price column.
cost_calc_help: View cost breakdown and food cost percentage for all registered menus
cost_calc_no_menus: No menus registered. Register menus in the "Menu Registration" tab first.
cost_calc_no_prices: Unit price data not loaded. Upload a CSV and run analysis in the "Inventory" tab first.
